text.p: Children's Broadcasting Corp said Friday it had signed a commitment letter for a $15 million loan from Foothill Capital Corp.

The loan, which will be secured by the assets of the company, will provide working capital and cash for the acquisition of more radio stations to grow the Radio AAHS(R) distribution system, the company said.
Foothill Capital is part of Norwest Corp.
Children's Broadcasting said the working capital will enhance the marketing and sales efforts that it has recently re-established in-house.
Closing on the financing is expected this month, subject to customary closing conditions.
Children's Broadcasting's Radio AAHS programming is a mix of music, news, stories and games, produced and distributed for children age 12 and under and their parents.
